blurb: Experience the perfect pairing of fresh pasta and craft spirits in this hands-on cooking class with a talented chef, hosted at a local distillery in Chicago! Learn the time-honored techniques of pasta-making as you mix, knead, roll, and cut your own pasta from scratch using just eggs, flour, and olive oil. Then, prepare a rich marinara sauce with onions, garlic and tomatoes, with the option to add beef for a meaty variation. Enjoy the lively atmosphere of the distillery, where you can sip on expertly crafted spirits while perfecting your culinary skills. Whether you’re a pasta lover, a food enthusiast, or just looking for a fun and interactive night out, this class is the perfect way to learn, sip, and savor. Book your spot today for an unforgettable pasta-making experience in the heart of Chicago!
